scope: Selected survey of friendship, farming, poverty and the full emotional arc of the third book of love poetry; not a translation of every couplet.
editorial_boundary: Project Madurai original Tamil text, 1330 couplets/133 chapters, cross-read with identified 1886 Pope/Drew/Lazarus English translation. English lecture is original critical narration rather than a replacement translation; precise dating and author religion not settled.
